q: The method of characteristics for a first-order PDE uₜ + c(x,t)uₓ = 0 gives the solution along characteristic curves x = x(t) defined by dx/dt = c(x,t). The solution satisfies:
opts: u is constant along characteristics: du/dt = 0
exp: Along the characteristic curve x(t) (with dx/dt = c): du/dt = uₜ + ẋuₓ = uₜ + c·uₓ = 0. So u is constant along each characteristic: u(x(t),t) = u(x₀,0). This reduces the PDE to a family of ODEs. Characteristics may cross (causing shocks) when c depends on u.
